offer.title: New to Manar? Take the 5 minute tour
offer.body: It points at the real console and lets you practise an approval and the kill switch in a sandbox.
offer.laterHint: You can start it any time from Help.

card.notOnPage: This part is not on the current page yet, so the tip shows here.
card.keys: Arrow keys move between steps, Esc pauses.
card.paused: Tour paused. Resume it from Help.
card.finished: Tour finished. Restart it any time from Help.

labels.governedHint: Manar decides each call the agent sends through it.
labels.observedOnlyHint: Manar sees activity but is not enforcing it.
labels.declaredOnlyHint: Registered, with no activity recorded yet.
labels.unavailableHint: Manar cannot see right now. Never read this as healthy.

practice.banner: Practice mode. Nothing here is real: no agent, tool or tenant is touched.

decision.prompt: Send a request as the agent and read the decision.

requests.signins: Read sign-in history for the reported user

reasons.allow: Inside the task's capability, and no rule asks for approval.
reasons.approval: policy_requires_approval: disabling an account needs a person to agree.
reasons.deny: forbidden_action: this task forbids password resets.

approval.prompt: The agent wants to disable an account. Decide.
approval.reasonValue: The account sent 40 phishing emails in 10 minutes.
approval.approved: Approved by you. In a real run the connector would run the action once, and the audit log would record that you approved it.
approval.denied: Denied by you. The agent gets DENY and nothing runs. The audit log would record your decision.

killSwitch.prompt: Stop the agent, then let it go again.
killSwitch.pulled: Every request from this agent is now DENY with reason agent_kill_switch_active, until a person releases it.
killSwitch.released: Released. The agent's requests are decided by policy again.

welcome.title: Every AI action has an owner
welcome.body: Manar sits between AI agents and the systems they touch. Each action an agent asks for gets a decision, a reason and a record. This tour takes about 5 minutes.

labels.title: Four labels tell you how much Manar controls
labels.body: AI systems and agents carry one of these. Read the label before trusting a number.

agentOpen.title: Meet an agent
agentOpen.body: Agents are the AI workers Manar governs.
agentOpen.task: Open Agents, then open any agent.

agentIdentity.title: Identity, task, allowed actions
agentIdentity.body: Each agent has its own identity. It works on a task, and the task lists the actions it may take. Anything outside that list is denied.

decision.title: Watch a decision
decision.body: Each request gets ALLOW, APPROVAL_REQUIRED or DENY, with a reason and the policy version that decided it. The same inputs always give the same answer.
decision.task: Send at least one practice request.

approval.title: Approve or deny one
approval.body: Risky actions wait for a person. You see what the agent wants, why, and you decide.
approval.task: Approve or deny the practice request.

approvalsQueue.title: Real requests wait here
approvalsQueue.body: The Approvals page lists what is waiting for a person. The tour does not act on these.

killSwitch.title: Pull the kill switch
killSwitch.body: When an agent misbehaves, stop it in one move. Only a person can release it.
killSwitch.task: Pull the practice kill switch, then release it.

auditOpen.title: Check the record
auditOpen.body: Every decision, approval and kill switch lands in the audit log.

auditVerify.title: Verify the hash chain
auditVerify.body: Each audit entry carries the hash of the one before it. Verifying recomputes the chain, so an edited or missing entry shows up.

auditExport.title: Export evidence
auditExport.body: Export a signed bundle of entries for an auditor. The same page can verify a bundle later.

policies.title: Policies are versioned
policies.body: Every decision names the policy version that made it. Publishing a new version never rewrites old decisions.

enrol.title: Enrol an agent
enrol.body: A new agent starts here. It gets a one-time enrolment token and then its own certificate. Nothing is created in this tour.

assistant.title: Ask the assistant
assistant.body: The assistant explains what you see in plain words. It advises, it never decides.
assistant.ask: Ask: why was a request denied?
assistant.prompt: Explain the last denied request: which rule decided it, and what would have to change for it to be allowed?

finish.title: You are set
finish.body: You have seen a decision, an approval, the kill switch and the record. Restart the tour any time from Help.
